jobs.title: Data Analyst
jobs.description:
Robert Half is representing a food manufacturing client in downtown Chicago on an open contract, with potential to be contract-to-hire, Data Analyst
opportunity. The ideal candidate is local to the Chicagoland area, but potentially open to fully remote options.

Responsibilities include:
Building out Excel dashboards
Financial modeling and forecasting in Excel
Overlap support with sales and marketing teams
Heavy sales data spreadsheet manipulation

The ideal candidate has:
Advanced Excel skills
Strong analytical skills
Experience with forecasting, cost analysis, data reconciliation & vendor management
Trade management/commercial finance experience
Strong communication skills
A startup mentality and comfortability with a startup environment
Consumer Packaged Goods (CPG) industry experienced highly preferred, if not then related food/beverage manufacturing or retail industry experience

Benefits available to contract professionals include medical, vision, dental, and life and disability insurance. Hired contract professionals are also eligible to enroll in our company 401(k)plan. Our specialized recruiting professionals apply their expertise and utilize our proprietary AI to find you great job matches faster.

jobs.title: Data Analyst - Business Intelligence
jobs.description:
DRW
is a diversified trading firm with over 3 decades of experience bringing sophisticated technology and exceptional people together to operate in markets around the world. We value autonomy and the ability to quickly pivot to capture opportunities, so we operate using our own capital and trading at our own risk.

Headquartered in Chicago with offices throughout the U.S., Canada, Europe, and Asia, we trade a variety of asset classes including Fixed Income, ETFs, Equities, FX, Commodities and Energy across all major global markets. We have also leveraged our expertise and technology to expand into three non-traditional strategies: real estate, venture capital and cryptoassets.

We operate with respect, curiosity and open minds. The people who thrive here share our belief that it’s not just what we do that matters–it's how we do it. DRW
is a place of high expectations, integrity, innovation and a willingness to challenge consensus.

The Data Analyst – Business Intelligence role will join DRW’s Unified Platform (UP) Data Management team. UP systems are responsible for data that spans the trade lifecycle: from research, execution, through to post-trade. Our business operations generate substantial data each day. Our global footprint produces inquiries from stakeholders that require complex answers. Questions can span years of data, multiple data stores and a variety of financial domains.

This is a reporting and analysis role at the intersection of finance, trading operations, and data engineering. The work is deadline-driven; your outputs go to regulatory authorities, external auditors, and firm leadership.

What You'll Do

Answer business questions with data

Build and run extracts against the firm's data stores to answer requests from the front office, and other units like Tax and Legal
Drive improvements to market share reporting and analytics
Support quarterly and annual tax and regulatory inquiries across multiple global jurisdictions
Respond to audit, litigation, and class-action data requests, often under short turnaround

Make the numbers trustworthy

Validate every extract before delivery — cross-foot detail against aggregates, reconcile against source systems, and investigate discrepancies rather than explaining them away
Document the business rules behind each report, including who made the decision and why

Reduce the recurring load

Identify patterns across incoming requests
Partner with engineering teams to translate those patterns into durable solutions: reporting dashboards, self-service views, scheduled reports
Write the specification: define the business logic, the edge cases, and the validation criteria that a tool needs to get right

What We're Looking For

Required

5+ years in a data analysis, business intelligence, financial reporting, or analytics engineering role
Advanced SQL — you are comfortable with complex multi-table joins, aggregation across different grains, CTEs, and reasoning about query performance.
Python for data work — pandas, database connectivity, and building repeatable scripts rather than one-off notebooks
Experience working with financial data: trades, positions, pricing, or reference data
Demonstrated care with accuracy.
Clear written communication — you'll be explaining methodology to accountants, lawyers, and auditors who don't read SQL
Bachelor's degree in a quantitative or technical field
Experience specifying requirements for engineering teams, or building BI tooling (Tableau, Power BI, or similar)
Exposure to tax, VAT/GST, or regulatory reporting

The annual base salary range for this position is $100,000 to $130,000 depending on the candidate’s experience, qualifications, and relevant skill set. The position is also eligible for an annual discretionary bonus. In addition, DRW offers a comprehensive suite of employee benefits including group medical, pharmacy, dental and vision insurance, 401k (with discretionary employer match), short and long-term disability, life and AD&D insurance, health savings accounts, and flexible spending accounts.

For more information about DRW's processing activities and our use of job applicants' data, please view our Privacy Notice at https://drw.com/privacy-notice.

California residents, please review the California Privacy Notice for information about certain legal rights at https://drw.com/california-privacy-notice.
